summary: The call included Neha Kapoor (CFO), Rahul (AE), Arjun Nair (VP Engineering) and referenced David Thomas (CISO). Neha compared Stratify’s price (₹34 L) to Northwind’s (₹48 L) and asked for justification beyond features. Rahul responded with incident cost data and proposed a 90‑day paid pilot costing ₹9 L, fully credited if continued, and agreed to send a TCO model, pilot terms, SOC 2 Type II report and DPDP data‑flow mapping. The conversation moved forward on the pilot and security documentation, while price justification and security clearance remain points of concern.
